decision: Keep shared contexts optional: fewer source-preparation visits and identical proofs do not produce a complete-worker gain. Preserve both improvements and regressions; no default changes.
limitations: All eight exposed chronological edits, two alternating serial repetitions. Each worker restores only its causal origin prefix and provisioned bank, never the cumulative union or a later query.

Ordinary and support controls are frozen. Context changes only short-guard support transport: lazily prepare one immutable canonical local CNF and position map per witness call, then check every selected clause, reason and conflict against that bound source.

The context is a local implementation value, never a persistent proof or trust token. Native compilation, publication and cold readers remain unchanged. No context survives a guard-call boundary; inconclusive graphs prepare none.
Native search remains capped at 256 dispatches; separately compiled proof nodes and previous gate limits are unchanged. This is not a bound on total work, process memory or verification.

The unchanged worker charges restoration, setup, solve, accounting, warm/cold native replay, serialization and compression. Imports, source hashing, protocol/case loading, earlier acquisition/extraction and final preservation audits remain additional.

All source/proof counters are compared except the specifically reduced position/normalization visits and new context-allocation counters. Identical counters and archive bytes do not establish identical ordered execution traces.

Provisioned banks, exposed edits, automatic origin discovery, wider guards and arbitrary-SAT bounds remain limitations. Fresh small unlabelled tests establish correctness, not fresh large-instance performance. Peak context slots are additional to bank-byte counters; RSS includes the whole worker.

Same-case identical compressed/raw archive hashes, table digests and verdicts reuse prior manifest-bound two-reader audits for all 24 target/arm archives. Every current trial and profile separately performs cold native replay. No novel rows are merged or new cumulative archive published.
The full prior cumulative bank and layered reader are preserved unchanged. No claim is made to re-prove all historical records in this audit.
next_target: Inventory bounded wide-clause covers in the augmented learned-guard graph, starting with the preserved 12-variable separation example, inconclusive sites and fresh SAT/UNSAT controls. Only then test a live policy.
obligations: Every selected learned edge needs exact source support; synthetic indices are never native clause indices.
Recompose under strengthened branch assignments, preserving actual wide-clause identity and checking all native nodes.
Charge scanning, bounded reachability, rejected candidates, template acquisition, compilation, retained state and cold replay.
The current example uses supplied templates and establishes recognizer separation, not failure of ordinary SAT solving or a measured runtime gain.
